result.topic_en: Euler presents four power-series solutions of the fourth-order differential equation for a vibrating elastic lamina, then adopts the particular solution y = cos(θθt)(A cos θx/b + B sin θx/b + C e^{θx/b} + D e^{-θx/b}) and verifies that it satisfies the equation.
result.transcription:
LAMINARVM ELASTICARVM. 459
$y = +P - \frac{x^4\, ddP}{1.2\ldots 4\, b^4\, dt^2} + \frac{x^8\, d^4P}{1.2\ldots 8\, b^8\, dt^2} - \frac{x^{12}\, d^6P}{1.2\ldots 12\, b^{12}\, dt^2} + \text{etc.}$
$+Qx - \frac{x^5\, ddQ}{2\ldots 5\, b^5\, dt^2} + \frac{x^9\, d^4Q}{2\ldots 9\, b^9\, dt^2} - \frac{x^{13}\, d^6Q}{2\ldots 13\, b^{13}\, dt^2} + \text{etc.}$
$+Rx^2 - \frac{x^6\, ddR}{3\ldots 6\, b^6\, dt^2} + \frac{x^{10}\, d^4R}{3\ldots 10\, b^{10}\, dt^2} - \frac{x^{14}\, d^6R}{3\ldots 14\, b^{14}\, dt^2} + \text{etc.}$
$+Sx^3 - \frac{x^7\, ddS}{4\ldots 7\, b^7\, dt^2} + \frac{x^{11}\, d^4S}{4\ldots 11\, b^{11}\, dt^2} + \frac{x^{15}\, d^6S}{4\ldots 15\, b^{15}\, dt^2} + \text{etc.}$

ticulari noſtrae aequationis acquieſcere; ſtatim autem

Satisfacit ſcilicet ſequens forma:
$y = \cos.\theta\theta t\,(A\cos.\tfrac{\theta x}{b} + B\sin.\tfrac{\theta x}{b} + Ce^{\frac{\theta x}{b}} + De^{-\frac{\theta x}{b}})$
vbi notandum coefficientes A, B, C, D eſſe quanti-
tates lineares; quam formam aequationi differentiali
ſatisfacere, tentanti patebit, fit enim

et
$(\tfrac{d^4y}{dx^4}) = +\tfrac{\theta^4}{b^4}\cos.\theta\theta t\,(A\cos.\tfrac{\theta x}{b} + B\sin.\tfrac{\theta x}{b} + Ce^{\frac{\theta x}{b}} + De^{-\frac{\theta x}{b}})$.
